address: 1st Floor, Great Northern Hotel, King’s Cross St Pancras International Station, Pancras Road, London,N1C 4TB
bio: Nestled in the heart of King’s Cross, RAILS restaurant is located on the 1st floor of the grade II listed Great Northern Hotel.  To celebrate the magnificent wizardry on their doorstep in King’s Cross, the team at RAILS restaurant have conjured an ‘‘Afternoon Tea That Must Not Be Named", celebrating all things from the much beloved book and film franchise. Join them for an enchanting selection of treats both sweet and savoury – from ‘‘Enchanted’’ Tomato Arancini, ‘‘Dragon-Smoked’’ Salmon & Crème Fraîche sandwiches, to Butterscotch Beer Panna Cotta, Chocolate Mousse Frogs and Crunchy Passionfruit ‘‘Golden Snitches’’. Let the magic begin!  Afternoon Tea is served Thursday - Sunday from 1pm to 5pm.  Vegetarian options are also available with 48 hours notice required.
